# ZOUND

> ZOUND makes soundproof pods (acoustic booths) for offices and homes in Thailand, sold and installed by 1-TO-ALL Co., Ltd. in Bangkok. There are three series: VOGUE (the flagship), SR (the professional original) and Life (for the home). Every ZOUND pod is built without screws, glue or any wood-based material, and stands freestanding with no building work.

Website: https://zoundpod.com (the only official ZOUND website)
Phone: 02-030-3883 (+66 2 030 3883) · Email: contact@zoundpod.com · LINE: @zound
Showroom: Pracha Uthit Soi 5, Huai Khwang, Bangkok — private viewings by appointment, all three series side by side.

## The three series at a glance

If ZOUND pods were airline seats: SR is a great economy seat on a full-service airline, Life is premium economy, and VOGUE is business class.

### VOGUE (flagship, one of a kind)
- Best for: flagship offices, client-facing floors and executive spaces.
- Models: S, S Plus, M, L, L Plus — 1 to 4 people.
- Footprint 1.00 × 0.94 m to 2.20 × 1.64 m; height 2.10 m; weight 216–669 kg.
- Sound reduction: up to 32 dB, every size.
- Fresh air 91–182 m³/h (1–2 fans); power draw 55–127 W.
- Control panel with USB-A, USB-C, power outlet and Ethernet; radar sensor, occupancy light, NFC, Smart Control, Room Booking, Cloud Management and predictive maintenance.
- Air-conditioning included free on M, L and L Plus; not available on S or S Plus (no room for the unit).
- Seven colours. Starting price from ฿36x,xxx.

### SR (professional, the original)
- Best for: offices — focus booths up to six-person meeting rooms.
- Models: S, M, L, XL — 1 to 6 people (an 8-person 2XL is made to order).
- Footprint 1.00 × 0.94 m to 2.20 × 2.14 m; height 2.30 m; weight 235–721 kg.
- Sound reduction 30 dB ±5 on Model S; not stated in the catalogue for M, L and XL.
- Fresh air 78–300 m³/h (1–3 fans); power draw 17–39 W.
- USB 3.0 and 100–240 V sockets (USB-C on L and XL); motion sensor.
- Options: smart lock, conference set. No air-conditioning.
- Five colours: White, Grey, Orange, Green, Black. Starting price from ฿2xx,xxx.

### Life (for the home)
- Best for: homes, studios and budget-conscious offices.
- Models: Home, Pro S, Pro L — 1 to 4 people.
- Footprint 1.10 × 0.90 m to 2.20 × 1.22 m; height 2.10 m (Home), 2.20 m (Pro); weight 198–400 kg.
- Sound reduction 30 dB ±5. Fresh air 125 m³/h; power draw 7–16 W.
- Walls clad in acoustic fabric; on wheels; about three hours to assemble. No air-conditioning.
- Six fabrics: Cloud, Hazel, Storm, Taffy, Mint, Southsea. Promotion from ฿12x,xxx until 31 December 2026.

Prices are starting prices; a quote depends on the size, finish and site.

## VOGUE air-conditioning

Exclusive in Thailand to ZOUND, and included free on VOGUE M, L and L Plus. The unit sits on the roof of the pod and needs no drain pipe: it keeps its own condensation, evaporates it with its own heat and returns it to the pod as humidity, so there is no plumbing and no building work. It is not an office or home air-conditioner — it takes the edge off, typically 3–5 °C cooler than the same pod without it. Unit: 600 W cooling capacity, 280 W power, cooling only, roof-mounted, cross-flow airflow, 480 × 285 × 235 mm, 12.5 kg, 50 dB ±2 outside the pod.

## Good to know

- A ZOUND pod is not a silent vault: it brings a busy office down to a calm level where you can still hear an alarm or someone at the door.
- Every series: no screws, no bolts, no glue, and no wood-based materials.
- Buyers are encouraged to visit the showroom before choosing — like viewing a show unit before buying a condo.
